meta.note: Open review items are published and nonblocking for a technically sound site.

rows.finding: No exact location, parcel, lease, rent, tenant entity, debt, basis or offer is available in the public brief.
rows.evidence: Historical models use placeholder rent/expiry and precise rankings.
rows.action: Keep observed fields blank; publish conditional decision rules and scenarios only.

rows.finding: Root model converts 8% of franchise AUV into a $150,000 rent assumption and uses 2032 midpoint expiry, then reports precise wealth differences.
rows.evidence: tools/model.py lines 31-47 and data/valuation.json A1/A3; generated root pages inherit these assumptions.
rows.action: Do not endorse historical dollar rankings; current model normalizes NOI to 100 and labels every assumption.

rows.finding: Prior ledger labels 89.6 composite / 97.8 earthquake as urban-LA or county values, but the cited official viewer URL is a Census tract (06037295103).
rows.evidence: session-18dacdea/data/metrics.json M-73 and source S24; FEMA now routes legacy viewer to RAPT.
rows.action: County score left blank; tract values are not county or parcel values.

rows.finding: Historical ULA logic must apply 4% only above $5.4M, not at equality, for post-June-2026 closings; jurisdiction and exemptions also matter.
rows.evidence: Official Finance FAQ threshold table; current tests cover equality and both bands.
rows.action: Use strict lower-bound comparison and parcel jurisdiction gate; obtain closing-date tax confirmation.

rows.finding: DOF projects county population decline while SCAG's adopted planning forecast projects growth; households rise in both official systems.
rows.evidence: DOF P-2A vs SCAG Appendix I; different baselines, methods and policy assumptions.
rows.action: Show both separately; never average them or convert population growth into rent growth.

rows.finding: BLS and EDD payroll/unemployment figures differ because of geography, seasonal adjustment and revision vintage.
rows.evidence: BLS November summary vs EDD September preliminary release.
rows.action: Label each series; do not splice them into one trend.

rows.finding: DataQuest default non-charter ACGR 86.2% differs from Dashboard combined 86.5% and four-year component 84.6%.
rows.evidence: Official CDE report filters and indicator definitions.
rows.action: Keep measures separate and do not assign district outcomes to the unknown subject school.

rows.finding: Public franchisor financials are not the subject franchisee's financials; current filing reports franchisee payment delays/deferrals.
rows.evidence: JACK Q3 FY2026 liquidity section and restaurant-count note.
rows.action: Require operator/guarantor financials and store rent coverage before credit scoring.

rows.finding: NNN acquisition cap 7.4% and portfolio WALT 10.2 years are diversified portfolio statistics, not this asset's cap rate or term.
rows.evidence: NNN FY2025 10-K Item 7 definitions.
rows.action: Use only as labeled context; subject value remains blank.

rows.finding: LAHSA 2026 count release and PDF returned runtime errors during review.
rows.evidence: Official search excerpt exists, but live primary retrieval failed.
rows.action: Leave count blank and flag; do not replace with third-party numbers.

rows.finding: FEMA county NRI ZIP download failed; legacy NRI application is retired.
rows.evidence: OpenFEMA download page retrieved; RAPT is current entry point.
rows.action: Leave county score blank; use methodology and official parcel portals instead.

rows.finding: Legacy CAL FIRE FHSZ viewer URL returned 404.
rows.evidence: egis.fire.ca.gov/FHSZ retrieval on 2026-11-08.
rows.action: Verified OSFM replacement page is now used; parcel lookup remains blank.

rows.finding: City's 2020-2024 UCR dataset is no longer updated; NIBRS replacement uses a different reporting system.
rows.evidence: Official dataset notice retrieved 2026-11-08.
rows.action: Do not call historical counts current; compute neighborhood trends only from a consistent current series.

rows.finding: USGS FAQ probabilities come from UCERF3, a 2014/2015 model family, not a newly estimated 2026-2056 window.
rows.evidence: USGS FAQ and 2015 time-dependent publication.
rows.action: Label model vintage and regional scope; no parcel damage probability.

rows.finding: Existing checkers validate source IDs and text patterns, not agreement between every generated sentence and the underlying source table.
rows.evidence: tools/check_site.py and historical verification pages.
rows.action: Current checker validates row links, blank unknowns, arithmetic, privacy and internal links; source-value audit is recorded separately.

rows.finding: Previously cited supplemental PDF could not be retrieved in this environment.
rows.evidence: investor.realtyincome.com Q4 2025 supplemental fetch failed.
rows.action: Use SEC-filed NNN benchmark instead; do not assert the inaccessible 7.3% figure as freshly verified.

rows.finding: Visitor business sales and jobs are modeled economic impacts from the official tourism organization, not government observations.
rows.evidence: 2025 report compiled by Tourism Economics and Los Angeles Tourism.
rows.action: Label source type and do not treat $42.6B as direct spending or GDP.

rows.finding: Third-party search snippets disagreed with the port's own loaded-import figure.
rows.evidence: Port release states 545,696 loaded imports for September 2026.
rows.action: Use the port release; exclude third-party variants.

rows.finding: Historical board contains stale in-progress rows and inconsistent workspace counts; current platform pins one Arena branch.
rows.evidence: COORDINATION.md A-H history; Session I appended without editing other claims.
rows.action: Preserve history, document branch exception, and change shared navigation only in final integration.

rows.finding: Historical education note contains a public institutional mailing-address pattern, not a personal or subject-property identifier.
rows.evidence: research/04-education.md line 11; current-session pages have zero identifier-pattern hits.
rows.action: Preserve historical file; keep current product anonymized and scan current pages separately.

rows.finding: Public repository and Pages can expose committed files; private owner/operator details must never enter the public product.
rows.evidence: No private documents were supplied or persisted in this session.
rows.action: Use placeholders, blank unknowns, automated identifier scans and no analytics/forms/uploads.
